title: Wear app: BG arrow not visible on Watch Face AAPS(DigitalStyle)
symptom: On the Wear app watch face AAPS(DigitalStyle), the BG complication does not show the direction arrow, unlike the original watch face view in version 3.0.0.1.
fix: The issue was fixed for the reporter on AAPS(DigitalStyle) in a later build, but no specific action or setting is described.
evidence_quote: @MilosKozak Fixed for me on AAPS(DigitalStyle). Feel free to close.
